The studio

Design direction with the whole business in view.

HS108 is an independent design studio based in India. The studio works across identity, industrial product design, digital experience, and the systems that hold them together.

Our perspective

The parts should explain each other.

A company is encountered through many forms: an identity, an object, a website, an interface, a photograph, a service. HS108's cross-disciplinary perspective helps those encounters tell a coherent story and support a clear business direction.

Clarity

Know what the work is for.

Start from the audience, offer, and business decisions at stake.

Craft

Take the details seriously.

Consider form, material, language, interaction, and implementation together.

Continuity

Build a useful system.

Give teams principles and patterns they can apply after the first delivery.

Working relationship

Senior design thinking, close to the work.

The studio is led by senior designers. A useful partnership depends on direct communication, honest recommendations, and a shared understanding of what the work needs to achieve.
